summary.intent: Debug and fix two issues with the `explain --generate` command: Codex checkpoints failing with 'transcript has no content to summarize' and Claude CLI failing with exit -1. The user wanted to address Codex support first.
summary.outcome: Added first-class Codex support to the `explain --generate` path by implementing Codex-aware transcript scoping and reusing existing Codex compact-transcript normalization. Fixed a semantic bug where offsets were incorrectly interpreted as response-item counts instead of raw line offsets, addressed Copilot/Bugbot review feedback, and pushed the changes to branch `codex-explain-generate`.

repo: Transcript handling is agent-specific: Claude/Cursor uses line-JSONL, Gemini/OpenCode use message-based JSON, Codex uses rollout event streams with session_meta/response_item/event_msg rows
CheckpointTranscriptStart is stored as a raw line offset, not a response-item or message count
The --generate path has two distinct phases: scope the checkpoint transcript, then normalize it into summary input shape
Codex compact-transcript logic already exists and should be reused rather than creating parallel parsers
Codex format detection needed widening to recognize scoped Codex transcript suffixes after session_meta is removed

code.finding: explain --generate delegates to ClaudeGenerator which shells out to local claude CLI, not an API call from Entire's side
ClaudeGenerator defaults to the summarization path; lacks explicit timeout handling around subprocess invocation
Existing Codex compact-transcript normalization logic was not being used by --generate path; needed to be called explicitly for Codex summarization
Original implementation incorrectly scoped Codex checkpoints using response-item offsets instead of stored raw line offsets, causing mis-scoping on transcripts with event_msg/turn_context rows

workflow: Test-driven development pattern: wrote failing tests first, then implemented to make them pass
Static code review before implementation identified the two-phase architecture needed (scope + normalize)
CI/linting failures were caught by Actions and Bugbot/Copilot, providing actionable feedback
Local builds were tested against real checkpoints before pushing; user ran the binary themselves
Multiple commit rounds were needed due to review feedback and lint failures; separated concerns cleanly

friction: Worktree sandbox blocked direct git branch creation; required escalation to create codex-explain-generate branch
Go build cache limitations required escalation for running targeted tests
Initial implementation had semantic bug (response-item vs line-offset mismatch) caught by review, requiring rework
Lint failure (goconst) in Actions run required investigation and second commit to fix
Multiple test/lint iterations needed before PR was clean
PR #875 was created in draft state with failures; required investigation of both semantic bugs and lint issues
open_items: Claude-side --generate timeout issue deferred for separate work (no timeout around subprocess, weak error handling on Ctrl-C)
User will manually test the Codex fix against demo-repository checkpoints (f8e8674105da, 84c774a39830) before full validation
